references.text: My enemies speak evil against me. Those who wait for my death say, "When will he die, and his name perish?"
Those who seek my life set traps; those who plot my ruin speak of my destruction and scheme deceit all day long.
For they open their mouths wide against me; they speak with a lying tongue.
I offered my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard. I did not hide my face from mockery and spitting.

I was like a lamb led to the slaughter. I knew nothing of their plans against me: "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, so that his name is remembered no more!"
The Lord called me from my mother's womb; from her womb he named my name.
Those who had seized Jesus mocked and beat him. They blindfolded him and asked, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"
